Subject: Follow-up: POC options & deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate you and Jordan taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the POC scope and deployment options.

Recap:
- Primary goals: validate inference latency at 99th pctile for ACME search flows, and confirm throughput for batch re-ranking (approx 50 qps).
- Data sensitivity: ACME wants the ability to isolate logs and control retention; legal asked about audit logs and KMS for keys.
- Preference signal: Your infra team indicated Dedicated capacity would be ideal for a production migration because of predictable throughput and SLA needs, but you wanted to benchmark Hosted for speed and setup friction.

POC options we discussed:
1) Hosted API quick trial (2 weeks) — fastest to stand up, lets us validate latency and accuracy against your sample traffic. Minimal procurement.
2) Dedicated pilot (4–6 weeks) — reserved GPUs with ingress-only private network peering. Good to validate sustained throughput and caching efficacy.
3) Private/VPC (on-prem / customer network) — recommended if ACME needs full network isolation and customer-managed KMS; longer lead time (6–10 weeks).

Proposed POC plan (attached: acme_poc_plan_v1.pdf):
- Success criteria:
  * 99th-percentile generation latency <= 300ms for single-turn search prompts
  * Sustained throughput >= 40qps with <5% error rate for re-ranking workloads
  * Logs & audit exports available to ACME SREs for retention verification
- Timeline:
  * Hosted trial: 2 weeks from kickoff (sandbox creds in 24–48h)
  * Dedicated pilot: 4–6 weeks (requires reserved capacity + networking)
- Stakeholders: Sara (ML Eng), Jordan (Platform), ACME procurement/legal, Redwood: me (Ben), Marissa (Solutions Engineer)

Next steps (propose):
1) Confirm whether you want to run the 2-week Hosted trial first or jump straight to Dedicated pilot.
2) If Dedicated/pilot preferred, can you share procurement timeline and the procurement contact?
3) Schedule a 30-min kickoff with your infra and ML leads — Marissa can cover onboarding checklist and sample traffic upload.

I attached a draft POC plan and a one-pager comparing Hosted vs Dedicated pricing. If helpful I can spin up a short pricing spreadsheet comparing committed months for Dedicated vs incremental Hosted usage.

Thanks — available most of next week for a quick sync.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
